concept.name: Data revision
concept.definition: A later correction, restatement, benchmark update, or methodological change to a previously released observation.
concept.intuition: It controls what information the model receives and in what numerical representation.
concept.mechanics: Store vintages and release times, use the then-available version in simulation, and separately test sensitivity to revised history.
concept.failure_modes: Fitting the operation on the full dataset leaks future information; revisions, outliers, and missing values can also distort results.
concept.misconceptions: A cleaner or rescaled dataset is not automatically more truthful; transformations must preserve timing and economic meaning.
concept.example: An earnings value reported as $1.00 in April and restated to $0.80 in August remains $1.00 for a May decision simulation.

citations.source: CFA Institute Research Foundation, Investment Model Validation
